IL is a chronic manifestation of the activity of bacteria in the canal system of teeth with/without previous endodontic treatment. On a global scale, 52% of the adult population has been identified with PI. in at least one of their teeth, reportedly [29]. Given the high prevalence and asymptomatic nature of PL.s, their early detection via radiography remains of the utmost importance for their management. CBCT-based studies have commonly reported a higher prevalence of PL in their population compared to other studies with periapical/panoramic assessments [29, 30].
